long_biography.plain_text:
Terry Hui studied electrical engineering in California but entered property development through projects owned by his father in Vancouver. He learned construction and planning on site, then worked alongside Victor Li as the former Expo lands began their transformation. When the Hui family acquired a controlling interest in Concord Pacific, Hui took the executive lead, making the family-backed business the centre of his career.

Under his direction, Concord extended its model of dense, master-planned residential neighbourhoods from Vancouver to Toronto and other markets. Hui has also invested in telecommunications, software and renewable power, reflecting his engineering interests, but property development remains the group's defining business. He continues to serve as its president and chief executive.
